conventions.convention: Natural units c=ℏ=1; spacetime is R^(1,3) with metric diag(-1,1,1,1). Physical action brackets are [U]_D=-I_D(U)/4 and [Y]_F=I_F(Y)/2; Hermitian conjugation is added once to F actions.

The global gauge group is a specified compact closed matrix subgroup of U(N), with inherited embedded Lie-group structure under AC_ω. Its Lie algebra consists of tangent matrices with commutator bracket; matter actions use complexified differentials of smooth unitary group representations.

The matter kernel is H=exp(-V), and Wα=-¼ barred-D²(H⁻¹DαH). In the selected fixed-real-coupling SU(2) bridge, V=-2gV30, Λ=-iΛ30, τ=πi/g² at zero theta, and g_h=2g. This is a classical density identity, not a quantum measure identity.

The prescription is formal and coefficientwise, with 0<λ<Λ0, topologically trivial backgrounds, a local derivative expansion, and an explicitly assumed one-particle-irreducible vertex functional. Real coefficient spurions have independent unconstrained anti-chiral jets before constant-background evaluation.

Every matter-independent quadratic invariant in W, including Abelian kinetic mixing initially placed in F, is collected into P_kin before defining F_rem. Nonrenormalization concerns unrescaled holomorphic coordinates.

U(1) parameters have period 2π, charges are integer weights counted with multiplicity, and ξ denotes the field-independent coefficient of [V1]_D. In the fixed-g auxiliary-component bridge, ξ_D=-gξ. Field-dependent real-linear couplings [LV1]_D are separate data.

load_bearing.statement: Under all the Statement's formal cutoff, local background-spurion, one-particle-irreducible vertex, locality, Ward-identity and anomaly-free hypotheses, F_rem,λ=F_rem coefficientwise; the collected gauge-kinetic coefficient vector receives no higher-loop corrections. For an unbroken U(1), FI corrections are one-loop only and proportional to the total left-chiral charge trace. Real D terms and canonically rescaled coefficients are not protected; nonperturbative, arbitrary 1PI and continuum-existence conclusions are excluded.

concerns.concern: Definition lines 81 and 91 include constant FI terms among G but promote independent real D coefficients to unconstrained real superfields while requiring the background gauge Ward identities. Applied to the bare ξ[V1]_D term, this gives [Pξ V1]_D, whose gauge variation is -[P_phys(Pξ)Λ1]_F plus its conjugate and is generally nonzero. The theorem's own step 6.1 establishes precisely this obstruction. No exemption for the bare FI coefficient, constrained background, or compensating transformation is specified. Clarify the background extension's admissible domain; otherwise its FI branch, including the example with a bare FI term, appears incompatible with its own gauge-invariance premise.

Proof 6.1 says the coupling-independent regulated tadpole integral 'is the same for each chiral component'. Independence from mass and interaction spurions does not establish independence from species-dependent choices in the fixed cutoff prescription. The Statement and action-data definition impose supersymmetry/gauge Ward identities but do not explicitly require a common regulator kernel across matter species. With distinct fixed profiles the displayed inference instead gives a weighted sum Σ_i q_i C_i, whose cancellation does not follow from Σ_i q_i=0. Supply the missing regulator-universality hypothesis or prove it from the declared prescription. This directly affects ex-qftx-n1-u1-fi-charge-trace. Weinberg's cited argument was read at https://arxiv.org/html/hep-th/9803099v1, equations (10)–(12) and the subsequent FI discussion; it does not supply a local derivation of universality for the broader unspecified prescriptions here.
